title: GDELT cyber share z>1 -> QQQ abs return 1-3d
hypothesis: R2 | [risk-macro-em] GDELT cyber GKG share 20d z-score > 1 leads QQQ absolute returns (realized volatility) higher by 1-3 days (+); trade long QQQ.abs_return 3d [gdelt.gkg.cyber_share -> finance.QQQ.abs_return] (parent: R2-0083)
message: Not supported: cyber GKG share z>1 vs QQQ abs return r=0.02, perm p=0.47, Bonferroni p=1.0; trade hit_rate 1.0 is an artifact of always-positive abs_return, excess return only +0.26%/10d

trade_idea.entry_rule: gdelt.gkg.cyber_share rolling_zscore_20d > 1 at close -> long QQQ next session
trade_idea.exit_rule: close after 10 trading days (no overlapping entries)
trade_idea.caveats: Backtest on daily closes, no costs/slippage; few independent regimes; signal and target may share the war as common cause.

followup_hypothesis: R2 | [risk-macro-em] GDELT cyber GKG share 20d z-score > 1 leads QQQ intraday range (range_pct) higher by 1-3 days (+); range_pct avoids the always-positive abs_return hit-rate artifact; trade long QQQ.range_pct 3d [gdelt.gkg.cyber_share -> finance.QQQ.range_pct] (parent: R2-0183)
